title: Mimosa Mornings
meta_description: Gulf Views, Steps From Beach, Elevator- Mimosa Mornings by Royal Destinations
description_expanded: Description: Mimosa Mornings by Royal Destinations Location: Grayton Beach Address: 81 Gulf Breeze Drive Details: Mimosa Mornings is an exceptional luxury retreat located in the private Gulf Trace neighborhood of Grayton Beach. Offering approximately 5,252 square feet of living space, this expansive home comfortably accommodates up to 16 guests with five bedrooms, six full baths, and one half bath. Soaring 10-foot ceilings, two spacious living areas, an elevator, and beautifully appointed interiors provide plenty of room for large families and groups to gather while enjoying the privacy of their own accommodations. Outdoor living is a highlight of Mimosa Mornings, with a private heated saltwater pool, hot tub, poolside cabana, and multiple porches offering expansive Gulf views. The cabana provides an additional gathering space complete with a full bath, outdoor refrigerator, sink, grills, and ping pong table. Surrounded by Grayton Beach State Park, Gulf Trace offers approximately one mile of beautiful shoreline, with private neighborhood beach access just 25 steps from the home. With exceptional amenities, generous gathering spaces, and an incredible location steps from the Gulf, Mimosa Mornings provides an unforgettable setting for your next 30A getaway. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Distance to Beach Access: Approximately 25 Steps to Private Neighborhood Beach Access -Parking Spaces: (1) in Garage and (4) in Driveway -Dining Accommodations: Table Seating for 8, Bar Seating for 6 -Coffee Maker Available -Private Heated Saltwater Pool* -Poolside Cabana with Full Bath -Elevator -Expansive Gulf Views -(2) Living Areas -Multiple Gulf-View Porches -Screened Sun Porch -Ping Pong Table -Butler’s Pantry -(2) Washers and Dryers -10-Foot Ceilings Throughout -Outdoor Gas Grill -Outdoor Charcoal Grill *Pool heat is available for an additional $60 (pre-tax) per night and must be arranged prior to arrival. *Pool heating is not recommended when ambient temperatures fall below 50 degrees, as the heater may be unable to reach the desired temperature. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 16 5 Bedrooms / 6.5 Baths Ground Floor: -Poolside Cabana with Ping Pong Table and Seating -Full Bath (Walk-In Shower) -Outdoor Refrigerator and Sink -Gas Grill and Charcoal Grill -Laundry Area -Garage First Floor: -Bedroom 1: King Bed with Private Bath (Shower/Tub Combo) and Gulf View -Bedroom 2: King Bed with Private Bath (Soaking Tub, Walk-In Shower, Double Vanity) and Gulf-View Balcony -Bedroom 3 (Bunk Room): (3) Twin/Twin XL Bunks with Private Bath (Shower/Tub Combo) -Living Room: Queen Sleeper Sofa -Laundry Room with Sink, Folding Counter, and Ice Machine -Balcony Second Floor: -Bedroom 4: King Bed with Private Bath (Soaking Tub, Walk-In Shower, Double Vanity) and Gulf-View Balcony -Kitchen / Main Living Room / Dining Area -Butler’s Pantry -Half Bath -Screened Sun Porch -Balcony Third Floor: -Bedroom 5 (Master): King Bed with Private Bath (Shower/Tub Combo) and Gulf-View Balcony Please Note: *Mimosa Mornings rents weekly only, with Saturday-to-Saturday stays required during Spring Break and Summer rate seasons. *LSVs and on-street parking are strictly prohibited within the Gulf Trace neighborhood. *Guests have access to one garage bay. *There are large homes under construction along the beach in front of Mimosa Mornings and elsewhere in the neighborhood. Construction may obstruct Gulf views and may result in construction-related activity during your stay. *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
